request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Fund Oura by TxPipe maintenance and enhancement over 12 months, including part-time maintenance, community support, documentation, protocol compatibility, bug fixing, performance improvements, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total requested withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Oura is a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.
Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and multiple sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS Lambda/S3/SQS, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and is the most starred project in the TxPipe portfolio.
Oura has been funded twice through Project Catalyst in Funds 9 and 13 for feature development.
The proposer states that Oura is used across the ecosystem for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance and enhancement through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts, asserting Oura's technical role, adoption indicators, prior funding, NCL compliance, Hydra voting support, and oversight arrangements.
